A driver that adjusts the format therefore has its DQBUF buffers processed with the wrong dimensions or format.

notes: ROS 1 (kinetic) package; all six packet elements are consumed, so declares and not_declared are empty by rule. The ioctls are issued with the package's own static xioctl() wrapper on fd_ (src/usb_cam.cpp:68-77) obtained from open() at src/usb_cam.cpp:1065. The device path is the runtime private parameter ~video_device with the hard-coded default "/dev/video0" (nodes/usb_cam_node.cpp:92), set to the same value in the shipped launch file; a different path can be supplied at run time. The fields are written into struct v4l2_format.fmt.pix before VIDIOC_S_FMT (src/usb_cam.cpp:988-992) together with type=V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE and field=V4L2_FIELD_INTERLACED; width and height are read back after the call (1000, 1003, 1007-1008), pixelformat is not. pixelformat_ is chosen from the ~pixel_format parameter (default "mjpeg", nodes/usb_cam_node.cpp:103; launch sets "yuyv") via UsbCam::start (src/usb_cam.cpp:1083-1115); width/height from ~image_width/~image_height (defaults 640/480, nodes/usb_cam_node.cpp:99-100).
